summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the Pahlawan Nusantara AR Expo app on mobile viewport (390x844). All critical flows pass: splash auto-redirect, home menu, heroes list/search, hero detail (TTS + AR buttons), AR viewer with full controls, AsyncStorage progress tracking (verified increment 0/20 -> 1/20), quiz interaction, QR codes page (20 cards), scan permission screen, guide/about. Zero console or page errors during the run.

issues: Spec mentions 'Shortcut emoji buttons untuk simulasi tanpa QR fisik' but only 3 testIDs render on /scan in web preview (scan-back-button, grant-camera-permission-button, non-ar-mode-button). Likely the simulation/shortcut emoji buttons appear only after user taps 'Mode Tanpa AR' or grants camera permission. Main agent should confirm shortcut buttons are accessible in default state OR document that they appear after entering non-AR mode.

action_items: Confirm/document the location of shortcut emoji simulation buttons on the Scan screen — they were not directly reachable on initial /scan render in the web preview (only camera-permission and non-ar-mode buttons exposed).
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx is ~560 lines and within budget but consider extracting MenuCard/featured carousel into separate components if it grows further.
All interactive elements use proper testID kebab-case convention.
AsyncStorage progress utility is well-isolated in /src/utils/progress.ts and verified working end-to-end.
No HTML elements or className usage detected — fully React Native compliant.
No raw text outside Text components observed; no red screen errors.
seed_data_creation: None (offline-first app, all 20 heroes + 10 quiz questions baked into frontend constants).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App preview URL: https://pahlawan-ar.preview.emergentagent.com/. Splash auto-redirects to /home after 3s (testID=splash-screen). All menu testIDs use main-menu-{name}-button. Hero list cards: hero-list-item-{id}. Detail page: play-audio-narration-button + hero-detail-ar-button. AR viewer: ar-close-button, ar-toggle-rotate-button, ar-zoom-in, ar-zoom-out, ar-reset, ar-narration, ar-view-bio-button. Quiz: quiz-question-text + quiz-option-{0..3}. QR cards: qr-card-{id} (20 total). Progress tracker auto-increments via AsyncStorage when /hero/[id] OR /ar/[id] is visited (verified). TTS expo-speech may be silent in web preview but onPress handler fires without errors. Use mobile viewport 390x844.
